# Error-envelope budget, measured 2026-11-01.
#
# Each line is `<scope> <counter> <n>`. A number may only go down; when it does,
# the gate fails until you write the new value here, so the file can never
# quietly describe code that no longer exists. Reaching `0` on every line is the
# end state of this round (docs/CHANGELOG.md, 2026-11-01 entry).
#
#   uncoded  error responses with no stable `code` — the frontend can only show
#            prose, so it cannot translate them
#   chinese  hard-coded Chinese prose on the error path — English by the end of
#            the round, because the language packs own the translated words
